verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The full-bleed pizza photo, which was the original's background, is now a small inset rectangle floating on white. The orange headline band sits about 70px above the photo instead of crossing it, so the layered look is gone. That leaves large empty white areas at the top and bottom, and the result looks like stacked pieces rather than a recomposed design. A's content block sits slightly closer to the vertical centre (about 160px of white above, 180px below). B is shifted up about 20px, which leaves more dead space at the bottom, so A is marginally less lopsided.
